subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Should WebChat allow the floating scroll-to-latest action to be hidden, make it less intrusive while retaining it, or keep it mandatory?
rationale: The action is the deliberate recovery control for users who disable or lose auto-follow, so its visibility and replacement behavior require explicit UX intent.

options.title: Add Visibility Preference
options.body: Persist a browser-local visibility setting and provide another accessible scroll-to-latest action when the floating button is hidden.

options.title: Reduce Visual Intrusion
options.body: Keep the action available but redesign its size, placement, or dismiss behavior.

options.title: Keep Mandatory Action
options.body: Retain current behavior because the floating control is the primary catch-up affordance.

recommendation.title: Add Visibility Preference
recommendation.body: Persist a browser-local visibility setting and provide another accessible scroll-to-latest action when the floating button is hidden.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combination of scroll-area history, current-module maintenance, and prior issue-level product review.
